responsibility: Implements CSKY ABI classification for FnAbi, deciding how aggregate and scalar arguments and returns are coerced into 32-bit register chunks, returned in up to two registers, or lowered indirectly when too large.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/csky.rs`, this file is about CSKY function-call ABI classification, deciding how aggregates and scalars are returned or passed in i32-sized pieces or indirectly, not about inline-assembly register syntax.
